FROM spot s
LEFT JOIN bakji_detail b ON b.spot_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail d ON d.spot_id = s.id
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.latitude BETWEEN #{nearby.swLat} AND #{nearby.neLat} AND s.longitude BETWEEN #{nearby.swLng} AND #{nearby.neLng}
AND s.type IN
#{type}
AND s.park_warning = FALSE
AND (s.type <> 'BAKJI' OR b.has_water = TRUE)
AND (s.type <> 'BAKJI' OR b.has_toilet = TRUE)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public_spot_setting ps WHERE ps.spot_id = s.id AND ps.setting IN
#{setting} )
AND NOT ( s.type <> 'BAKJI' AND ( ((d.closed_from IS NOT NULL OR d.closed_until IS NOT NULL) AND (d.closed_from IS NULL OR d.closed_from <= #{nearby.today}) AND (d.closed_until IS NULL OR d.closed_until >= #{nearby.today})) OR (d.closed_from IS NULL AND d.closed_until IS NULL AND d.operating_status IS NOT NULL AND d.operating_status IN ('TEMPORARILY_CLOSED', 'PERMANENTLY_CLOSED'))))
AND <= #{nearby.radiusMeters}
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.type AS type, s.name AS name, s.latitude AS lat, s.longitude AS lng, s.park_warning AS park_warning, pd.operating_status AS operating_status, pd.closed_from AS closed_from, pd.closed_until AS closed_until, n.distance_meters AS distance_meters FROM ( SELECT s.id AS spot_id, AS distance_meters
ORDER BY distance_meters, s.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) n JOIN spot s ON s.id = n.spot_id LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail pd ON pd.spot_id = n.spot_id ORDER BY n.distance_meters, n.spot_id
